name: Git Push
description: Push the current HEAD to a non-protected feature-style branch on origin without force or history rewrite.

repo_path.description: Relative path to the target git repository

steps.description: Validate the current branch bounds and push current HEAD to the approved feature-style branch on origin

constraints: Only the current HEAD can be pushed
The remote is fixed to origin
Only feature-style branch names are allowed; protected branch names are excluded by pattern
The wrapper validates current-branch identity, detached-HEAD state, and remote existence before push
No force, delete, amend, or alternate git flags can be injected
invariants: The recipe only performs git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch> through the bounded wrapper
Protected branch names like main, master, and release/* are not valid inputs
Non-fast-forward updates still fail under normal git push semantics
